summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new admin 'Contenu' tab (ContentPanel + ContentEditor) for La Maison d'Auben. Verified 14/14 task scenarios: (1) Admin login OK, 'Contenu' tab appears between 'Produits' and 'Commandes' with data-testid admin-tab-content (actual tab order: products, content, orders, newsletter, messages). (2) Content list renders 6 cards with data-testid content-product-<slug> for all 6 products (budget-mensuel, budget-couple, car-cost, first-apartment, suivi-sportif, travel-manager), each with status badge (Disponible/Bientôt disponible), thumbnail, and content-edit-<slug> button. (3) Clicking content-edit-budget-couple opens content-editor-budget-couple pre-filled with existing content. (4) Edited content-name + content-description + content-seo-title, clicked content-save-btn → PUT /api/admin/products/budget-couple returned 200, backend fetch confirmed new name/description/seo persisted, public /boutique/budget-couple reflected new H1 and description. (5) Added a feature (content-add-feature → content-feature-title-<i>, content-feature-text-<i>, content-feature-icon-<i>=Heart), saved; new feature appears in Fonctionnalités section on the public page. (6) Gallery: content-add-gallery, uploaded a PNG via content-gallery-upload-<i>, caption via content-gallery-caption-<i>, saved → public page shows a real gallery item (gallery-item-0) and lightbox opens on click. (7) Reorder/delete gallery: added a second slot, used Monter button (swap confirmed in form state), then Supprimer; saved via content-save-btn-bottom → backend gallery ordered correctly ('Deuxième T1' moved to index 0, other item deleted). (8) FAQ: content-add-faq, content-faq-q-<i>, content-faq-a-<i>, saved → new accordion item visible on public page. (9) SEO: content-seo-title edit persisted (backend verified; public <title> currently keeps server-rendered original until client hydration — the Seo component updates it, acceptable 'best-effort'). (10) content-preview-btn href = /boutique/budget-couple (correct). (11) NON-REGRESSION availability: throughout all edits on budget-couple, buy-now-btn stays absent and 'Bientôt disponible' is displayed on its public page. (12) NON-REGRESSION budget-mensuel: still 7,99 €, price unchanged (7.99), has file, buy-now-btn present on /boutique/budget-mensuel, clicking it redirects to checkout.stripe.com (cs_test_ session, no payment attempted). (13) SECURITY: PUT /api/admin/products/budget-couple without token → HTTP 401 'Non authentifié'. POST /api/admin/upload/image with a non-image text file (authenticated) → HTTP 400 'Image non autorisée. Autorisées : gif, jpeg, jpg, png, webp'. Without any auth header the same upload returns 401. (14) Produits tab non-regression: tabs navigation OK, admin-product-<slug> rows render with price/file/image controls (verified visually; no mutation performed on this run beyond content fields).
critical_code_review_comments: ContentEditor uses useState initializer only on mount; when ContentPanel invalidates ['products'] after save, a NEW product object is passed as prop but editor state does not re-sync with latest server values. For now this is fine because the edited form IS the source of truth during a session, but if the user leaves the editor and comes back without unmounting, drift is possible. Minor — current onBack unmounts the editor so no real-world risk.

SEO <title> update: the public page title refresh depends on the Seo component re-reading product.seo.title on client. OK for SPA navigation, but a hard reload shows the cached HTML title until React mounts — acceptable per 'best-effort' spec.

ContentEditor caption/field onChange closures rebuild arrays from `form.gallery`/`form.features` captured at render time. Playwright works fine with the current 200–400 ms waits between actions, but humans typing fast after a background upload resolve could occasionally race. Consider using functional updater `setForm(f => ({...f, gallery: ...}))` consistently (already done via `set` helper for the top-level key, but inner `const n = [...form.gallery]` reads stale closure). Low priority.

data-testid content-save-btn is used TWICE (top header + bottom) with identical value. Playwright locator('[data-testid=content-save-btn]') resolves to the top one which is fine, but strict mode would complain. A unique suffix (already present as content-save-btn-bottom) is better; consider renaming the top one to content-save-btn-top for symmetry.

On the gallery slot aspect ratio (16/11), the placeholder 'Capture à venir' remains until a real image is uploaded — good UX. After upload the is cover-cropped; add alt text (currently alt="") if accessibility is desired.

ContentPanel passes product directly without a key prop; if editing one product then clicking another without going back to the list, state would persist across products. Current flow always goes through the list (back button sets editing=null), so safe, but a key={product.slug} on <ContentEditor /> would be a cheap safety net.

success_rate.backend: n/a (no pytest run; 2 ad-hoc security checks pass)

test_credentials: admin@lamaisondauben.fr / Auben2026! (/admin/login) — works. No real Stripe payment performed; only redirect to checkout.stripe.com with cs_test_ session verified for budget-mensuel.
seed_data_creation: During testing, budget-couple content was mutated multiple times (name/description/SEO/feature/FAQ/gallery). Final restore via direct PUT /api/admin/products/budget-couple (authenticated) brought budget-couple back to the seed state: name='Budget Couple', price=null, 6 features (originals), 3 FAQ items (originals verbatim from seed_data.py), 3 placeholder gallery slots (captions: Dépenses communes / Répartition / Projets, placeholder:true). budget-mensuel untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ContentPanel data-testids follow strict pattern: content-product-<slug>, content-edit-<slug>, content-editor-<slug>, content-name, content-short-description, content-badge, content-description, content-audience, content-main-image (hidden input), content-feature-<i> (wrapper), content-feature-title-<i>, content-feature-text-<i>, content-feature-icon-<i>, content-add-feature, content-gallery-<i> (wrapper), content-gallery-upload-<i> (hidden input — use page.set_input_files on the testid), content-gallery-caption-<i>, content-add-gallery, content-contents-<i> + content-contents-add, content-compatibility-<i> + content-compatibility-add, content-faq-<i>, content-faq-q-<i>, content-faq-a-<i>, content-add-faq, content-seo-title, content-seo-description, content-save-btn (top), content-save-btn-bottom, content-back-btn, content-preview-btn. Monter/Descendre/Supprimer buttons for list items are identified by title attribute (title="Monter"|"Descendre"|"Supprimer") inside their row's data-testid wrapper. The admin PUT /api/admin/products/<slug> accepts partial updates (exclude_unset) and NEVER modifies price/file/status unless those fields are explicitly in the payload — ContentEditor save() never includes them, so availability is preserved. Admin upload /api/admin/upload/image enforces image mime (gif/jpeg/jpg/png/webp) → 400 otherwise. All admin endpoints need Bearer token → 401 without.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. All requested scenarios pass.
